The order is fixed and row-major: M10,M11,M12,M13,M14 on the first row; M15,M16,M17,M18,BO02 on the second row. Each entire body is complete and isolated in its own cell, no extra monster and no duplicates. Center each silhouette in its own cell. Each monster including roots, long necks, limbs, weapons, fungal sails, tails and eight boss roots must fit inside the CENTRAL 60 PERCENT of its cell. At least 20 percent fully blank transparent gutter on all four cell edges. Invisible grid, ample empty gaps, no object overlap and no clipping.
Locked art direction, exact Chinese standard: 明亮手绘卡通奇幻风，古典遗迹融合魔法蒸汽机械，高机位三分之四斜俯视、近等距构图，2.5D立体质感，暖阳光照与清新鲜明配色。
Reference art direction: the provided game image has warm cream and pale-stone highlights, saturated coral armor, jade and teal magical forms, blue-violet facets, gold/brass machinery, painted surface detail, crisp deep-plum silhouette linework, clear solid top and side planes, strong three-quarter volumes. Use this rendering standard for the monsters only. DO NOT reproduce scenery, UI, floor, hero or other subjects from the reference.
View/pose: ALL TEN monsters face RIGHT, their front/head/proboscis/drill nose pointing toward the image's right edge. A consistent HIGH CAMERA looking down at a near-isometric THREE-QUARTER FRONT angle. Full idle bodies in a stable ground-contact stance, all legs and feet clearly readable and complete. For the naturally drifting fungal sail mother, its three hanging brood cords define the complete lower body and ground anchor; do not invent humanoid legs. None are side-profile flat silhouettes or front-facing icons. No cropped portraits.
Style: bright polished HAND-PAINTED CARTOON fantasy enemies with genuinely physical 2.5D thickness, rounded or faceted anatomy as appropriate, clear overlapping limbs, painted texture, cream sunlight highlights, crisp dark-plum outlines. Threatening predatory creatures with sharp attack appendages and watchful narrow eyes where anatomically appropriate. Dangerous monsters, NOT cute mascots, toys or plush companions. Keep the exact organic fungal/root/insect identities. Steam machinery belongs where specified, especially the boss drill wreckage; do NOT turn all the organic monsters into robots.
Color: FULL COLOR and strongly differentiated materials. Fresh jade greens, coral pink/red/orange fungal tissues, blue-violet shells/crowns, cream highlights, restrained polished gold/brass on mechanical remnants. Each monster has its own varied palette and clear anatomy. NO overall brown/rusty mining look, no sepia, no monochrome grey, no gloomy shadow creatures, no photorealism, no flat glyphs, no repeated recolored bodies.

Four complete short root-like feet; no acid droplets or projectile outside body.

Full sail and all hanging sacs within cell. No detached babies.

Crown has exactly four petals, clear layered dimensional bell shape and visible drum abdomen, right-oriented predatory feature. Full body and planted lower appendages.

Entire broad jaws, all short planted legs and layered fungal roof/back visible. Low heavy shape clearly different from M16.
10. BO02 温床织母 / Nursery Weaver Mother, the biome B02 BOSS. A large terrifying organic-mechanical fungal queen: a SEMITRANSPARENT mushroom CROWN covers recognizable MINING DRILL WRECKAGE, and EXACTLY EIGHT THICK ROOT LIMBS radiate in a PETAL-LIKE silhouette. Full eight roots with separate visible contact tips; countable, all complete inside cell. The body has a luminous jade/coral semitranslucent fungal dome with cream gills and blue-violet crown lobes. Within and beneath it is polished gold/brass ruined drill apparatus with a clear drill nose facing RIGHT. The eight thick jade/coral roots curve into a stable petal ring around the mechanical core. Looks powerful and dangerous, not a cute mushroom or a copy of one smaller enemy. Keep the complete boss within its one cell; no extra floor petals or surrounding effects.
Lighting/background: consistent warm upper-left sunlight painted onto body surfaces only. TRUE alpha-zero transparency outside each complete body and between every body. NO baked checkerboard, white/colored background, scenery, floor, terrain, ground rings, cast shadows, external glows, dust, fog, particle spray or disconnected effects.
Avoid: NO text, names, letters, numerals, cell frames, labels, UI or floor. NO one-tone brown/rust/grey bodies. NO flat icons, photorealism, cute chibi mascots. NO missing feet, cropped weapons/tails, overlapping cells, duplicated silhouettes, extra monsters. Exactly ten distinct complete FULL-COLOR bodies. All face RIGHT.
